reference_character.summary: PC-001 is the positive literary-visual benchmark for the bounded pilot because its plates combine mathematical orientation, narrative sequence, atmosphere, annotation, and explicit claim boundaries rather than treating imagery as decorative accompaniment.
observed_strengths: A dominant visual object establishes wonder and orientation before technical annotation.
Small diagrams, labels, definitions, and process sequences orbit the main composition rather than fragmenting it into a dashboard.
Each major plate has a narrative movement: question, transformation, control, reconstruction, or consequence.
Visual metaphor is permitted but the surrounding text explicitly states where the metaphor yields to exact mathematics.
The illustrated layer, prose layer, technical appendix, and source layer form progressively higher-resolution views of the same mathematical story.
The plates are designed for orientation, memory, and delight while remaining non-authoritative as proof diagrams.

binding_quality_principles.name: memorable_true_mental_model
binding_quality_principles.requirement: A corrective plate must do more than remove a false mental model; it must give the reader a memorable substantially true one within its declared representation class.

binding_quality_principles.name: hero_composition
binding_quality_principles.requirement: The principal mathematical object or process should dominate the visual hierarchy; explanatory annotations should support it rather than compete with it.

binding_quality_principles.name: narrative_movement
binding_quality_principles.requirement: The composition should make the mathematical movement legible: orientation, construction or transformation, relation or invariant, then consequence or boundary.

binding_quality_principles.name: atmosphere_with_semantic_discipline
binding_quality_principles.requirement: Atmosphere, texture, depth, and decorative scientific motifs may create wonder, but must not impersonate mathematical data, scale, topology, or evidence.

binding_quality_principles.name: annotation_economy
binding_quality_principles.requirement: Labels, equations, inset definitions, and callouts should be few enough to preserve a composed plate and sufficient to prevent the intended visual inference from drifting.

binding_quality_principles.name: precision_ladder
binding_quality_principles.requirement: The image should hand the reader cleanly to prose, equations, appendices, and sources; higher-resolution layers restore precision without repudiating the intuition established by the plate.

binding_quality_principles.name: claim_boundary_legibility
binding_quality_principles.requirement: The non-evidentiary boundary and material schematic departures must remain discoverable without visually overwhelming the teaching object.

binding_quality_principles.name: literary_coherence
binding_quality_principles.requirement: A plate should feel authored for its mathematical subject and surrounding documentary, not generated from a subject-independent card or dashboard template.
